description: Vercel offers a REST API that includes endpoints for managing authentication tokens.

evidence.claim: Vercel offers a REST API that includes endpoints for managing authentication tokens.
evidence.notes: Endpoints listed for token creation, listing, and deletion.

evidence.claim: Authentication can be performed using Access Tokens.
evidence.notes: Access Token required to use Vercel API.

evidence.claim: Authentication can be performed using SSO Token exchange.
evidence.notes: POST /v1/integrations/sso/token endpoint provides SSO token exchange.

evidence.claim: Users can create authentication tokens themselves via API.
evidence.notes: POST /v3/user/tokens endpoint allows creation of an Auth Token.
Documented as Vercel REST API reference.
